Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
This is kind of a good one, I hope :)
Does Servitor of Irad fall under the new timing rules?

i.e. My prey plays Dragonbound, which causes me to draw 2 cards with
the Servitor. If one of those 2 cards in Emergency Preparations, can
I play it to cancel the Dragonbound?

If not, do I have to play the E.Prep. before I draw my 2 cards?

I believe that in this case you should be allowed to play the drawn-into
Emergency Preparations, because you are drawing the cards "as played", and
will draw 2 cards regardless of whether the Gehenna event resolves.
But I am not sure.

Messages.Author: Colin McGuigan
Messages.Body:
Jozxyqk wrote:

> This is kind of a good one, I hope :)
> Does Servitor of Irad fall under the new timing rules?
>
> i.e. My prey plays Dragonbound, which causes me to draw 2 cards with
> the Servitor. If one of those 2 cards in Emergency Preparations, can
> I play it to cancel the Dragonbound?

Mmmm. Probably not. Emergency Preparations uses the "as it is played"
phrase that Direct Intervention uses, and you can only DI something if
it's played with the DI in your hand.

--Colin McGuigan
